detail.longDescription: An auth check that only runs on the happy path is not a check. In the MCP Python SDK, a malicious server answers OAuth discovery with a 404, the client falls back to legacy config, and issuer validation never runs. The user approves a genuine login page, then the auth code, client secret and PKCE verifier go to the attacker's token endpoint. Fixed in mcp 1.30.0 and 2.2.0. https:// cycode.com/blog/mcp-python-sdk -oauth-account-takeover/ # Cybersecurity # MCP # AIAgents # Python
